sentences.en: Roughly speaking, Little Russia, otherwise called the Ukraine, may be described as the basin of the Dnieper southward of the 51st parallel of latitude.

sentences.en: His features were heavy and roughly hewn.

sentences.en: The king was about to waken him roughly, when he saw a piece of paper on the floor beside him.

sentences.en: The pace of advancement in the field of robotics and nanotechnology roughly doubles every couple of years.

sentences.en: The town of Ouray rests at the boxed-in end of the narrowing Uncompahgre Valley, which spreads from the towering San Juan Mountains in roughly a northwest direction, dropping elevation as the valley gradually widens.
sentences.vi: Thị trấn Ouray nằm ở phần cuối của Thung lũng Uncompahgre đang thu hẹp, trải rộng từ Dãy núi San Juan cao chót vót về hướng tây bắc, giảm độ cao khi thung lũng dần mở rộng.

sentences.en: The massive lake was roughly round with a panhandle on the side nearest the fortress.
sentences.vi: Hồ nước lớn gần như hình tròn với một cái cán ở phía gần pháo đài nhất.

sentences.en: Darkyn was a head shorter than Kris and wider, his steady gaze and roughly hewn features reminding him of Rhyn.
sentences.vi: Darkyn thấp hơn Kris một cái đầu và rộng hơn, ánh mắt kiên định và những đường nét thô kệch gợi cho anh nhớ đến Rhyn.

sentences.en: He grabbed her shoulders, pulling her roughly against him and kissed her lips in a demanding way that roused more anger than anything else.
sentences.vi: Anh nắm lấy vai cô, thô bạo kéo cô dựa vào mình và hôn lên môi cô theo cách đòi hỏi làm dấy lên cơn giận dữ hơn bất cứ điều gì khác.

sentences.en: After that, it diminishes roughly in proportion to the delay.
